notes.title: Shadow Master Achievement should now be achieving correctly.
notes.content: Made a change where the Shadow Master Achievement for getting five stars in all Sound Katakana lessons was not being completed. This is now fixed. Those who already got five stars in all lessons should get the achievement upon game boot or completing a single lesson.

notes.title: Clicking is working now past Chapter screen.
notes.content: There was a discrepancy in the way Unity polls mouse position clicks in windowed mode compared to editor mode. To not go into details, it is consistent in how it is used, except when you do a standalone window mode. So you have to use different variables between the two. It works now, and everything is normal again. Sorry for the fluke in the press release kickoff. Please update and enjoy!
